verdict.rationale: Previewing candidate actions before acting is a fair question for a browser-automation agent API, so the axis applies. The documented session primitives are run_task, goto, extract, evaluate_js and close, plus live view and takeover, but none of them returns candidate actions or a plan for review before the agent commits. Extract only returns page data and live view only shows actions as they happen, so there is no evidence of an observe/plan capability.
